name: gd-build
displayName: GD Build — Unity slice, tests, FMOD
description: Continues the gd pipeline in Claude Code: build a playable Unity 6 slice and milestone systems via a free Unity MCP with a verify loop, independent code review, juice measured in frames, UI Toolkit screens from the HUD spec, asset import against the asset list, EditMode/PlayMode/smoke/visual-diff/soak tests, and FMOD sync with banks and audio import (headless via fmodstudiocl). Degrades to plan + checklist without MCP. Free tools only.
